hero.heading: Two Acres, Entirely Yours
hero.subtitle: A private five-bedroom villa and pool in Kolhapur — booked whole, never shared.

about.text: Bade Farms is a five-bedroom villa set in two acres of private green on the edge of Kolhapur, a few minutes from Ratnappa Kumbhar Nagar. You book the whole property — the house, the pool, the lawns and the parking — so there are no other guests, no shared spaces and no fixed schedule. It suits a family weekend as easily as a pool party, a wedding or a company day out.

stays.title: The Whole Villa
stays.description: All five bedrooms, the living areas, the pool and both acres — yours for the booking, with nobody else on the property.

stays.title: Pool Parties
stays.description: A crystal-clear pool, open lawn and covered seating — set up for birthdays, reunions and get-togethers that run into the evening.

stays.title: Weddings & Events
stays.description: Two acres with room for 250 seated or 500 standing, a bridal suite, in-house catering and parking for fifty cars.

stayNote: Bade Farms is only ever let as a whole property, so your group has the house, the pool and the grounds to itself. Message us for dates and a quote.

items.title: Nothing Shared
items.text: Five bedrooms, the pool and two acres go to one booking at a time. No other guests, no shared lawn, no fixed timings.

items.title: Room To Celebrate
items.text: 250 seated or 500 standing across the grounds, with a bridal suite, power backup and parking for fifty cars.

items.title: Food Your Way
items.text: In-house catering does both veg and non-veg, or bring your own cook and decorators — outside vendors are welcome.

plans.name: Event Day
features: Exclusive use of all two acres

items.q: Do we get the whole property to ourselves?
items.a: Yes. Bade Farms is let as one booking at a time, so the villa, the pool and both acres are yours for the duration of your stay or event.

items.q: How many people can you host?
items.a: Around 250 seated or 500 standing across the grounds for an event. For an overnight stay the villa has five bedrooms.

items.q: Can we bring our own caterer and decorators?
items.a: Yes. In-house catering is available for both veg and non-veg menus, and outside caterers and decorators are welcome.
There is space for around 50 cars on the property.
